text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- President Jorge Sampaio is unhappy with the performance of Macau Governor Rocha Vieira and wants to see more flexibility in talks leading to the transition of the territory to China in 1999, the paper learned.
- Portugal must present figures for the 1996 budget deficit to the European Union in Brussels at the end of this week. The figure is expected to be four percent of Gross Domestic Product.

- President Sampaio is angry with the way Portuguese journalists are covering his official visit to Macau and China. He said he wanted to hold briefings with journalists every day to tell them what is of national interest.
- The Portuguese subsidiary of Bank Tokyo-Mitsubishi made a profit of 316 million escudos in 1996, a 19.3 percent hike compared with 1995.
